## Prerequisites

- Applies to Atlas 800T A2 training cards, 8 cards on a single node; set NPUS_PER_NODE to 8 in the training script.
- Image tag: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, CANN 9.2.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0; install the host driver and firmware first.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and datasets to ./dataset; the matching mount points in the container are /weights and /data.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image is available: the list should contain mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 for the current card.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: keep the 910b chip segment of the image tag at the end of the command, replace /data and /weights after -v with real host directories; the command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual 8 cards.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script:

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

- Image tag: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12; start the container on every node with the same tag.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, CANN 9.2.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0; install the host driver and firmware first.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> on each node and datasets to ./dataset; the matching mount points in the container are /weights and /data.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image is available: the list on every node should contain mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 for the current card.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: keep the 910b chip segment of the image tag at the end of the command, replace /data and /weights after -v with real host directories; the command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual 8 cards per node.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## Prerequisites

- Applies to Atlas 800T A2 training cards, 8 cards on a single node; set NPUS_PER_NODE to 8 in the training script.
- Source installation does not use a container; to use the image instead, the tag is mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

Run the pretraining script:

```bash

```

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell

    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..

```shell

    git checkout 26.2.0

## Prerequisites

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD multi-node, 8 cards per node; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script, NNODES is the total number of nodes.
- Image: in container mode use mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12; source installation is performed on the host.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 and MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, PyTorch 2.10.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0, Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; every node needs this data.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes, and NODE_RANK must differ between nodes.

## Installation

Create and activate an isolated virtual environment; prepare Python 3.12.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: non-root users use the default path in the commands below, root users use /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh instead.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install Triton-Ascend: the matching version is 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Install MindSpeed Core: switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Prepare the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources: switch Megatron-LM to core_v0.12.1 and copy it into MindSpeed-LLM, then install the dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining launch command; for multi-node it must be started on every node at the same time.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## Prerequisites

- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Source installation does not use a container; to use the image instead, the tag is mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> on each node and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

```bash

```

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell

    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..

```shell

    git checkout 26.2.0

## Prerequisites

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD multi-node, 8 cards per node; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script, NNODES is the total number of nodes.
- Image: in container mode use mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12; source installation is performed on the host.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 and MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, PyTorch 2.10.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0, Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; every node needs this data.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes, and NODE_RANK must differ between nodes.

## Installation

Create and activate an isolated virtual environment; prepare Python 3.12.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: non-root users use the default path in the commands below, root users use /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh instead.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install Triton-Ascend: the matching version is 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Install MindSpeed Core: switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Prepare the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources: switch Megatron-LM to core_v0.12.1 and copy it into MindSpeed-LLM, then install the dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining launch command; for multi-node it must be started on every node at the same time.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## Prerequisites

- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Source installation does not use a container; to use the image instead, the tag is mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> on each node and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

```bash

```

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell

    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..

```shell

    git checkout 26.2.0

## Prerequisites

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD multi-node, 8 cards per node; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script, NNODES is the total number of nodes.
- Image: in container mode use mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12; source installation is performed on the host.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 and MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, PyTorch 2.10.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0, Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; every node needs this data.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes, and NODE_RANK must differ between nodes.

## Installation

Create and activate an isolated virtual environment; prepare Python 3.12.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: non-root users use the default path in the commands below, root users use /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh instead.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install Triton-Ascend: the matching version is 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Install MindSpeed Core: switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Prepare the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources: switch Megatron-LM to core_v0.12.1 and copy it into MindSpeed-LLM, then install the dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining launch command; for multi-node it must be started on every node at the same time.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## Prerequisites

- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Source installation does not use a container; to use the image instead, the tag is mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> on each node and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

```bash

```

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell

    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..

```shell

    git checkout 26.2.0

## Prerequisites

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD multi-node, 8 cards per node; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script, NNODES is the total number of nodes.
- Image: in container mode use mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12; source installation is performed on the host.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 and MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, PyTorch 2.10.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0, Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; every node needs this data.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes, and NODE_RANK must differ between nodes.

## Installation

Create and activate an isolated virtual environment; prepare Python 3.12.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: non-root users use the default path in the commands below, root users use /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh instead.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install Triton-Ascend: the matching version is 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Install MindSpeed Core: switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Prepare the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources: switch Megatron-LM to core_v0.12.1 and copy it into MindSpeed-LLM, then install the dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining launch command; for multi-node it must be started on every node at the same time.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## Prerequisites

- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Source installation does not use a container; to use the image instead, the tag is mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> on each node and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

```bash

```

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell

    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..

```shell

    git checkout 26.2.0

## Prerequisites

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD multi-node, 8 cards per node; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script, NNODES is the total number of nodes.
- Image: in container mode use mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12; source installation is performed on the host.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 and MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, PyTorch 2.10.0, TorchNPU 26.2.0, Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; every node needs this data.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes, and NODE_RANK must differ between nodes.

## Installation

Create and activate an isolated virtual environment; prepare Python 3.12.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: non-root users use the default path in the commands below, root users use /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh instead.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install Triton-Ascend: the matching version is 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Install MindSpeed Core: switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Prepare the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources: switch Megatron-LM to core_v0.12.1 and copy it into MindSpeed-LLM, then install the dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining launch command; for multi-node it must be started on every node at the same time.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## Prerequisites

- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

- Source installation does not use a container; to use the image instead, the tag is mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> on each node and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change the weights, dataset, card count and parallelism parameters in the example to match your script.

Run the pretraining script: for multi-node, open a terminal on every node and start them at the same time; in each terminal change only NODE_RANK, and set MASTER_ADDR to the master node IP on all nodes; if the nodes have no shared storage, add --no-shared-storage to the script.

```shell
    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh
```

> Source: https://gitcode.com/Ascend/MindSpeed-LLM/blob/26.2.0/docs/zh/pytorch/training/install_guide.md

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

```bash

```

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell

    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..

```shell

    git checkout 26.2.0

## Prerequisites
