## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 800T A2 single node, 8 cards, `NPUS_PER_NODE=8`; install the NPU driver and firmware on the host first.
- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; host Docker must be 26.1.4 or later.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

Run the msrun launch command per node: `master_ip` is the IP of Rank 0, `node_rank` increases per node, and `port` is chosen within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 800T A2 multi-node, 8 cards per node, `NPUS_PER_NODE=8`; install the NPU driver and firmware on every node's host first.
- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel on every node (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers and parallel sharding under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

```

```bash
docker run -itd \

  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Hardware: Ascend 950DT PR single node, 8 cards, `NPUS_PER_NODE=8`; install the NPU driver and firmware on the host first.
- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; host Docker must be 26.1.4 or later.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `950` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; host Docker must be 26.1.4 or later.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a3` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the 8 cards of each node; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

Run one on each node: `master_ip` is the IP of Rank 0 on all nodes, `node_rank` increases from 0 per node, and the total card count `16` and per-node card count `8` at the end must be changed to the actual node count.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a3` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel on every node (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

- Hardware: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, single node with 8 cards; NPUS_PER_NODE=8 in the launch script.
- Image: mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12.
- Version set: MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 branch; the image tag already includes CANN 9.1.0 and torch_npu 2.7.1.post8.
- Weights and dataset: put weights in ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the dataset in ./dataset; point CKPT_LOAD_DIR and DATA_PATH of the script to these two locations.
- Script directory: the launch script is in your model directory; change NPUS_PER_NODE, MASTER_ADDR, NNODES and NODE_RANK before launch.

## Installation

Confirm the image: check the local image list and confirm that the image for the current card has been pulled.

```bash
   # Check whether the image was pulled successfully
   docker image list
```

Start the container: the example command mounts only davinci0, add --device for the actual number of cards; replace /data and /weights in -v with real host directories, and replace the image tag with the tag for the current card.

```bash
   docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
```

Run the pretraining launch command.

    bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_8b_4K_ptd.sh

Create and activate an isolated virtual environment; prepare Python 3.12.

    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies

## Prerequisites

- Hardware: Atlas 800T A2 single node, 8 cards, `NPUS_PER_NODE=8`; install the NPU driver and firmware on the host first.
- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; host Docker must be 26.1.4 or later.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

Run the msrun launch command per node: `master_ip` is the IP of Rank 0, `node_rank` increases per node, and `port` is chosen within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `950` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `950` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Version set: MindSpeed LLM 26.2.0 branch, MindSpeed Core 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1, CANN 9.2.0 and TorchNPU 26.2.0.
- Download weights to ./model_from_hf/<model-dir> and the Alpaca dataset to ./dataset; fill these two paths into the training script.
- The launch script is in examples/mcore/qwen3 of the MindSpeed-LLM code directory; change the card count, weight, tokenizer and dataset paths before launch.

## Installation

Create and activate a Python 3.12 virtual environment so that the installation does not affect the global Python environment.

```bash
   conda create -n test python=3.12
   conda activate test
```

Configure CANN environment variables: the process-level environment script must be sourced before running training code; non-root users run it with the default installation path.

```shell
   # Default installation path for non-root users
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
```

Install the matching Triton-Ascend 3.6.0.

```shell
   pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

Get the MindSpeed Core source, switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch, then install the dependencies and install in editable mode.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
    cd MindSpeed
    git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1  # Switch to the 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1 branch of MindSpeed Core
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt
    pip3 install -e .
    cd ..
```

Get the MindSpeed-LLM and Megatron-LM sources, switch to the core_v0.12.1 and 26.2.0 branches, create the log directory and install the remaining dependencies.

```shell
    git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
    git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git  # Download Megatron-LM from GitHub; make sure the network can reach it
    cd Megatron-LM
    git checkout core_v0.12.1
    cp -r megatron ../MindSpeed-LLM/
    cd ../MindSpeed-LLM
    git checkout 26.2.0
    mkdir logs

    pip3 install -r requirements.txt  # Install the remaining dependencies
```

- Hardware: Atlas 800T A3 multi-node, 8 cards per node, `NPUS_PER_NODE=8`; install the NPU driver and firmware on every node's host first.
- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; host Docker must be 26.1.4 or later.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a3` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the 8 cards of each node; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

Run one on each node: `master_ip` is the IP of Rank 0 on all nodes, `node_rank` increases from 0 per node, and the total card count `16` and per-node card count `8` at the end must be changed to the actual node count.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

```bash

git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```

- Image tag for this card: `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-950-openeuler24.03-py3.12`; this record installs the environment directly on the host and does not enter a container.
- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Source installation of r2.0.0: clone the r2.0.0 branch and run `build.sh`, which builds the wheel and installs MindFormers from the Tsinghua mirror.

```bash
# r2.0.0 version (r2.0.0 branch, corresponding to the 2.0.0 release)
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

Install HyperParallel (required for dynamic graph training): the trainers, optimizers, parallel sharding and fused operators under `mindformers/pynative/` all directly `import hyper_parallel`; without it no dynamic graph task can run.

```bash
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Deployment

Start pretraining: the following is a framework-level example and the real launch script is in your model directory; change master_ip, node count and configuration file paths in the example to match your model directory.

For single-node execution, change the total card count `16` at the end of the command to `8`, set `master_ip` to this machine's IP, set `node_rank` to 0, and choose `port` within 50000~65536.

```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

> Source: https://www.mindspore.cn/mindformers/docs/zh-CN/master/installation.html

- Version set: MindSpore Transformers r2.0.0, MindSpore >= 2.10 (latest version recommended); CANN and firmware/driver match the selected MindSpore version.
- Weights: download TeleChat3-36B-Thinking from ModelScope; pretraining from scratch does not need weights. The dataset is WikiText-103; after converting it to Megatron format, point `data_path` to the data prefix under `./dataset` (without suffix).
- The launch script is `scripts/msrun_launcher.sh` in the repository, and task configurations are under `configs/telechat3/`; change `master_ip`, `node_rank` and `port` before launch.

## Installation

Pull the image for this card: replace `<chip-arch>` in the command with `a2` and the OS distribution with `openeuler24.03`, i.e. `2.0.0-a2-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-<chip-arch>-ubuntu22.04-py3.12
```

Start the container: `--device` mounts only one card, `davinci0`; add `--device=/dev/davinciN:rwm` for the actual 8 cards; replace `--name` with the container name and `<image-name:tag>` with the image pulled in the previous step.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name <container-name> \
  <image-name:tag> \
  /bin/bash
```
